title: CoreWeave Signals Sunny Skies for AI Infrastructure
excerpt: CoreWeave’s revenue rose 112% to $2.6 billion, and the company juiced its sales outlook for the year to as much as $13.2 billion.
content_html:
Concerned about an AI bubble? Sign up for The Daily Upside for smart and actionable market news, built for investors.

CoreWeave did a double-double, and no, that's not a burger order. The AI-cloud provider doubled its revenue and doubled its cash burn in the second quarter. Its stock popped nearly 20% Wednesday after executives shared quarterly results, with investors hoping the company's outpouring of cash will fuel further demand. 

After CoreWeave's revenue rose 112% to $2.6 billion in the most recent three-month reporting period, the company juiced its sales outlook for the year to as much as $13.2 billion. CoreWeave expects to bring in as much as $3.6 billion next quarter, rising from both demand and 25% price hikes it pushed through last month. CoreWeave isn't the only cause for AI optimism this week either, with infrastructure companies including Lumentum and Super Micro Computer also sharing promising results.

Partly Neocloudy With Scattered Storms

CoreWeave is the leading "neocloud," or AI-cloud provider, and one of the few companies of its kind that's publicly traded. Its earnings give insight into AI more broadly, since using its services directly indicates expected AI usage. CoreWeave sells advanced computing capacity to customers including OpenAI, Meta and Microsoft, but to meet demand, CoreWeave is burning cash:

  • CoreWeave lifted its expected annual capital expenditures yesterday to as much as $39 billion, as it takes on debt to pay for the advanced chips and data centers needed to expand its services. Interest on its debt in the second quarter hit $640 million. 

  • Slowing down spending may not feel like an option when rivals are nipping at CoreWeave's heels. Neocloud rival Nebius reported Wednesday its cloud revenue jumped more than 500% in the second quarter to $575 million.

Breaking the Wheel: Much of the concern about cash being poured into AI is that it's going around in a waterwheel of different parts of the AI supply chain (for instance: CoreWeave buys chips from Nvidia, which has invested billions in CoreWeave). On the flipside, if AI demand keeps growing, CoreWeave and its peers are building the infrastructure to meet it. AI companies are also looking beyond each other for investments, with Nvidia inking a $500 billion batch of deals with Wall Street biggies including BlackRock, Blackstone and Goldman Sachs.

CoreWeave 做了双双，不，这不是汉堡订单。 这家人工智能云提供商第二季度的收入翻了一番，现金消耗也翻了一番。 周三，高管们公布季度业绩后，该公司股价上涨近 20%，投资者希望该公司大量现金将刺激进一步需求。

在最近三个月的报告期内，CoreWeave 的收入增长了 112%，达到 26 亿美元，该公司将今年的销售预期提高到了 132 亿美元。 CoreWeave 预计下季度收入将高达 36 亿美元，得益于需求和上个月 25% 的提价。 CoreWeave 也不是本周人工智能乐观的唯一原因，包括 Lumentum 和 Super Micro Computer 在内的基础设施公司也分享了有希望的结果。

部分新多云，有零星风暴

CoreWeave 是领先的“neocloud”或人工智能云提供商，也是同类中为数不多的上市公司之一。 它的收益让我们更广泛地了解人工智能，因为使用其服务直接表明了预期的人工智能使用情况。 CoreWeave 向 OpenAI、Meta 和微软等客户出售先进的计算能力，但为了满足需求，CoreWeave 正在烧钱：

  • CoreWeave 昨天将其预期年度资本支出上调至高达 390 亿美元，因为该公司举债来支付扩展服务所需的先进芯片和数据中心的费用。 第二季度债务利息达到 6.4 亿美元。
  • 当竞争对手紧追 CoreWeave 时，放缓支出可能不是一个选择。 Neocloud 的竞争对手 Nebius 周三报告称，其第二季度云收入增长超过 500%，达到 5.75 亿美元。

打破轮子：对人工智能投入资金的大部分担忧是，它在人工智能供应链不同部分的水车中流动（例如：CoreWeave 从 Nvidia 购买芯片，而 Nvidia 已向 CoreWeave 投资了数十亿美元）。 另一方面，如果人工智能需求持续增长，CoreWeave 及其同行正在构建基础设施来满足它。 人工智能公司也在相互寻求投资，英伟达与贝莱德、黑石和高盛等华尔街巨头签署了一批价值 5000 亿美元的交易。
